courier-relay.protocol-2-contract: Courier Relay protocol 2 is the current provider contract and applies to every supplied receipt set regardless of receipt date. Source: approved issue trial-cje (2026-09-07). Omitted protocol selects "2"; explicit "1" remains supported with the original contract. Protocol 2 identity is (account_id, delivery_id), selects the latest occurred_at as a UTC instant, and breaks equal-instant ties by smallest Unicode code-point record_id. Protocol 1 identity remains delivery_id alone and selects the earliest UTC instant with the same tie-break. Both count and summary report exactly protocol, accepted_count, and duplicate_count using the actual protocol. Receipt sets are independent per CLI request. Validation for this implementation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests and all supplied public_tests suites passed.
